name: orca
description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Codex). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
one_liner: A desktop and mobile control room for running several different AI coding assistants side by side, so you can compare their results and steer them from your phone.
buyer: A developer who already pays for several AI coding tools and wants one dashboard to run, compare, and monitor them, instead of juggling separate terminal windows.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer runs the same task across three agents in parallel worktrees, picks the best result, and bills the client for less time than doing it by hand.
A small dev team reviews AI-generated diffs together inside the app, leaving line comments the agent can act on, instead of a separate code-review tool.
A remote-work developer uses the mobile companion app to get notified and steer an agent mid-task while away from their desk.

money_ideas.idea: None realistic for a third party — Orca is already a polished, monetizable product in its own right rather than a base to build on top of.

steal_this: Download it and run the same prompt across two different agents in parallel worktrees this weekend to see which one actually gives you a better answer, faster.
